lastResponse.text: You’re doing exactly what you need to do, and it’s okay to cry. Let’s keep this simple: have your shutoff notice and proof of income in front of you. If we get disconnected, call Portland General Electric right away at 503, 228, 6322 — that’South 5-0-3, 2-2-8, 6-3-2-2 — and say, “I need emergency bill help and disconnection protection today.” I’m staying with you while we get the live agent.
